qc.label_under_test: the word right after a rare specialist name or acronym (drug, agency, project, technical term), whatever it is: "(", "'s", a comma, "and", "for" or a verb; not after common or personal names

neighbours.label: the token right after a specific named product, drug, agency or acronym in technical or institutional text (Diamox, EPA, Amazon S3): "(", "'s", a comma or "and"; much weaker after generic descriptions, quiet after everyday nouns and personal names
